articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Zoom And Vizrt AI Tools Put Meeting Engagement In Investor Focus. Vizrt and Zoom launched two AI-powered applications, InteractifAI and CaptivAIte, for use during Zoom meetings. The tools allow presenters to overlay customizable visuals directly on video streams to support corporate communications, webinars, and presentations. The partnership highlights Zoom Communications (NasdaqGS:ZM) focusing on AI use cases and expanding its product ecosystem.
